title: Observability Query Library and Investigation Guides
content:
Purpose:
This working doc collects pragmatic observability queries, trace inspection patterns, and short investigation narratives focused on inference services (token-serving, KV cache, batching, model fallbacks). The goal is to give oncall engineers and feature owners a compact troubleshooting cookbook they can copy-paste and adapt during incidents. Treat as living: add small, validated queries rather than monolithic dashboards.

How to use: quick checklist
- Start with the short investigation narrative for the symptom you see.
- Run the provided queries against Prometheus/TSDB, traces, and logs in parallel (prefer PromQL and trace filters first).
- Annotate the timeline with recent deploys / rollout changes (check rollouts dashboard).
- If key metrics point to resource saturation, pivot to infra queries; if traces show expensive attention/kernels, escalate to serving-runtime.

Investigation narratives (short flows)
1) Symptom: sudden median and p95 token latency increase for hosted API
   - First-pass checks (5 min):
     * Confirm service-level SLO breach: look at per-route p50/p95 on latency timeline.
     * Check regional capacity: GPUs in region, cluster autoscaler events.
     * Check fallback events: count of requests routed to fallback model variant.
   - PromQL snippets to run:
     * p50 and p95 for request_duration_seconds by route (10m window):
       histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[10m])) by (le, route))
       histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[10m])) by (le, route))
     * Fallback count (events exported as counter):
       sum(rate(inference_fallback_events_total[5m])) by (route, model_variant)
     * GPU saturation (NVIDIA exporter):
       sum by(instance) (rate(nvidia_duty_cycle[1m]))
   - Trace checklist:
     * Filter traces for route X, look for long spans in "model.infer" and repeated "kv.fetch" spans.
     * If KV fetch spans dominate 90% of trace time, inspect cache hit rate and key distribution.
   - Typical remediations: increase batch timeout config for route, temporarily route traffic to dedicated capacity, rollback recent model config that increased seq length.

2) Symptom: high error volume with 5xx and gRPC CANCELLED during heavy parallel requests
   - Quick checks:
     * Error ratio by backend (model-serving pod vs frontend proxy).
     * Connection pool saturation between proxy and runtime.
   - PromQL snippets:
     * Error ratio by backend: sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (component) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) by (component)
     * gRPC cancelled count (instrumented): sum(rate(grpc_server_cancelled_total[5m])) by (service)
     * Connection pool utilization (if exported): avg(rate(conn_pool_in_use[1m])) by (cluster, pool)
   - Trace patterns to look for:
     * Many short-lived client spans ending with STATUS_CANCELLED from callers. Correlate with client-side timeouts (client_request_deadline header).
     * Long queue spans upstream of runtime indicating backlog.
   - Notes: often caused by small client timeouts + transient queueing. Short-term fix: bump client timeout or enable retry-with-backoff on callers.

Metric/field definitions (quick glossary)
- request.duration_seconds: server-side end-to-end duration from request receive to final bytes sent. Unit: seconds. Labels: route, model, customer_tier, region.
- model.infer.duration_seconds: pure model execution time (kernel + decode). Unit: seconds. Labels: model, gpu_type, batch_size, seq_len.
- kvcache.hit_ratio: ratio = kvcache_hits / (kvcache_hits + kvcache_misses). Unit: [0,1]. Labels: route, tenant_id, model.
- batch.size: histogram of batches formed by serving runtime. Labels: route, model, gpu_node.
- fallback.events_total: counter of automatic fallbacks (model variant or region). Labels: from_model, to_model, route, reason.
- queue.wait_seconds: time spent waiting in server-side request queue before worker pick-up.

Trace inspection primers
- Tagging conventions to filter quickly: span.name follows component.action pattern (eg. inference.runtime.decode, inference.kv.fetch, inference.router.dispatch). Prefer filtering by span.tag:route and span.tag:request_id.
- Useful trace queries: find traces where "model.infer" span > 80th percentile of model.infer.duration_seconds for the last hour. In Jaeger/TraceUI, search for span.operationName:model.infer and sort by duration.
- Common trace anti-patterns to flag: repeated synchronous external calls inside token loop, large number of tiny synchronous KV calls, batch formation waiting on slowest request (head-of-line blocking).

Dashboard panel templates (copyable text for Grafana or similar)
- Panel: Route latency heatmap
  * Query: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
  * Visual: heatmap by route rows, time on x-axis.
- Panel: Batch size distribution
  * Query: sum(rate(batch_formed_total[5m])) by (le, route) and histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
  * Visual: stacked area for percent of requests in each batch-size bucket; separate small panel for median batch size.
- Panel: KV cache heatmap by tenant/model
  * Query: topk(20, kvcache.hit_ratio{env="prod"}) or kvcache_hit_rate = sum(rate(kvcache_hits_total[5m])) by (tenant, model) / sum(rate(kvcache_requests_total[5m])) by (tenant, model)
  * Visual: table with sort by request volume, show hit ratio and recent trend sparkline.
- Panel: Fallback events and reason breakdown
  * Query: sum(rate(fallback_events_total[5m])) by (route, reason)
  * Visual: bar chart with reason colors; list recent trace ids as links if available.

Investigation queries (examples for logs and traces)
- Logs (structured logs via Loki):
  * Find errors for route X in last 15m: {job="inference-frontend", route="/v1/complete"} | json | status >= 500 | sort_desc | limit 100
  * Correlate a trace id across logs: {trace_id="abc123"} | line_format "${time} ${component} ${message}"
- Traces (Jaeger/Tempo):
  * Search by tag: route=/v1/complete and duration>2000ms. Use timeframe 1h.

Ownership and quick contacts (who to loop in)
- Serving-runtime perf issues (model.infer spans, batching): eng-serving-runtime -> @Carlos Mendes (pager), @Samir Gupta (oncall).
- KV cache and caching policy issues: infra/serving -> @Lena Horowitz.
- Routing/fallbacks and rollout policy mistakes: product-hosted-api -> @Aisha Patel.

Notes and gotchas
- Metric cardinality: don’t add tenant_id as a label on high-cardinality request metrics; instead use sampled or aggregation index metrics for per-tenant troubleshooting.
- Histograms vs summaries: prefer histograms for aggregated p95s across instances; summaries are useful only for single-instance retrospection.
- Traces are sampled — when investigating rare regression, increase sampling rate for target route for 15–60 minutes to collect enough traces.

To add a new snippet: validate the query on staging, paste final text here, add a 1-line purpose, and tag an owner.

Recent entries history
- 2025-01-10: Added fallback.events_total query and panel (Aisha).
- 2025-02-01: Added batch size distribution panel and example PromQL (Carlos).
- 2025-02-12: Clarified tracing tag conventions; added sampling note (Lena).

Unresolved questions (todo)
- Standardize a compact per-tenant troubleshooting metric that avoids label explosion but gives useful signal. (owner: eng-observability)
- Agree on a single trace attribute name for model variant to make cross-slice filters trivial.

End of doc.
